sentences.text: This holiday season, Americans are expected to spend over 21 billion dollars on buy now, pay later.
Every 'later' is a piece of your future you already sold.
The rich don't buy now and pay later.
They pay now, and buy later.
Wait. Save. Then buy it in cash.
So before you click 'buy'... ask yourself: who will pay for this?

mood_cue.calm: he said slowly and calmly, like a wise mentor.
